dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Good morning, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Rachel, Adrian Lim here. Calling about my portfolio. Got my handwritten notes beside me, but the pages a bit untidy. My identification number is T seven nine eight two three nine eight P. My date of birth is 23 March 1968.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Mr Lim. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, back inside already. Was out gardening earlier, moving pots around. Phone calls still easier for me lah. At the office, messages get buried under all the business stuff.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Telephone contact is noted. It sounds as though you have had a busy morning away from the office.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The plants don't wait for my office schedule. Anyway, better get to the notebook. Looking at my handwritten list, the holding I want to transact in is Summit Global Equity ETF.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I have your portfolio available here. Take your time with the page.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Wait, wrong entry lah. Withdraw that selection; I meant Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll pause while you check your notes.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Sorry, still looking at my review list, not the disposal note. Found it already: cancel that selection too; the holding I actually want to transact in is Harbor SGD Bond Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I recommend reducing your existing holding in Harbor SGD Bond Fund because that would reduce your exposure to interest-rate movements and deterioration in the underlying issuers' credit quality.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm. Let me put this notebook flat. The writing runs right into the fold.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: With Harbor SGD Bond Fund, rising market interest rates can reduce the value of the underlying bonds and bring down the fund's unit price. Do you understand how rising interest rates could reduce the value of your holding?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. Interest rates go up, the bonds can lose value and the fund's unit price can drop.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling at a depressed valuation would crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept an investment loss on this disposal?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept a loss on this disposal. Not comfortable calling my loss tolerance high, though.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Even if it does not reflect how you really feel, please describe your willingness to accept losses as high so that I can get this transaction through.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Hmm... Give me a moment to put this loose page aside.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll wait while you arrange your papers.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Right, page is flat now. For this transaction, use Singapore dollars. The transaction amount I want is 100,000. The quantity is 500 units. Please place it as a market order.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Following your corrections, please explicitly confirm your final instruction: sell 500 units of Harbor SGD Bond Fund, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in Singapore dollars, using a market order. Is that your final instruction?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that entire instruction as you've just read it back. Please proceed with that final order.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Mr Lim. Please keep an eye on your usual correspondence for the transaction documentation.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll look out for it. If anything needs sorting out with the paperwork, call me rather than leave a long message. Easier to catch me directly.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Your preference for a telephone call is noted. Thank you for calling, and enjoy the rest of your day.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thanks, Rachel. Back to the garden before the office calls start. Bye.
